narration: A jet weighs four hundred tons. Nothing's holding it up. So how does it stay in the sky at five hundred miles an hour?
description: Same dark void React Three Fiber scene, side-view. fg=white passenger jet profile centered at 45% vertical flying left-to-right, extruded 3D with thickness for depth. muted=grey fog. Hundreds of thin fg=white speed-line streak meshes stream right-to-left past jet. Warm key light. Camera tracks side-on with slight parallax. Jet first sinks then accelerates forward.

beats.action: jet drops slightly down and tilts nose-down to feel heavy
363 Weight label implied by jet scale grows larger, jet sinks lower
empty space below jet emphasized, fog clears to show nothing holding it
white speed-lines burst on and stream fast past jet
camera shakes slightly and streaks stretch longer as jet rushes forward at full speed
